relationship_to_r20: independent; R20 remains the effective production index
signal_time: D close after all D features are available
positive_rule: first target hit within D+1..D+20; no pre-target breach of target-specific drawdown floor; after target day no low below D+1 open

classes.1: N1 target missed and drawdown floor not breached
classes.2: N2 drawdown floor breached before target or target never reached after breach
classes.3: N3 target reached then a later session fell below D+1 open
classes.-1: ambiguous: target-day low below D+1 open, intraday order unknown

ambiguous_policy: exclude from binary and reason-model losses

data_split.purge_rule: training horizon_end_date must be earlier than the next segment start
data_split.fold_adjustment: retain B0 test windows; use two-month calibration windows so matured 20-session labels exist before each test starts

model_stage_1.reason_models: one four-class model per target after ambiguous exclusion
